body: You have to have the clear intention that you want to be Free. In this birth. In this lifetime, this time around. Now—not at any lime in the future, but right now. This is what you have to want, and you have to mean it, and you have to be willing to stake your life on it. It means there's nothing that's more important to you than Liberation. If you’re that serious and that one-pointed about it, you can't fail. 2 6
